channel.title: Canopticon — Prices & markets
channel.description: Questions researched in depth, and articles written from what the research found.

item.title: Measuring the economy with new instruments: scraped prices, card-spending trackers and satellite imagery
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: Four old arguments explain why an economy resists being computed, and none of them have gone away. What computation did change is measurement — scraped prices, card records and satellite images that report what is happening weeks before the official numbers do.

item.title: Personalised pricing software and the return of haggling, run from the seller's side
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: From the middle of the nineteenth century everyone paid the number on the tag. Pricing software is bringing the bazaar back — except this time the seller reads you, and you see nothing.
